message: Just wanted to say that I've been following your blog for a month or so now and I really appreciate your perspective. I'm recently out of the military myself (Navy aircraft tech) and now am an English Writing Major who is very interested in rhetoric as well. I am constantly noting the vast structural differences between my own military mindset and that of inquiry required by my major. I'm learning how to use both, and also have made this difference a part of my summer study, so I read your posts that address this with much interest. From what I've read, you seem to be in such a unique position of immersion in an environment rich with varying cultures: ethnic, military, and academic. Your posts describe the interwoven nature of this in your daily life so well. Thanks for taking the time to post--looking forward to reading more.
